data_fields.name: stealth
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 by default; Obfuscation glyph boost otherwise

data_fields.name: melee_reach
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 tile (adjacent); ChampionEnemy extra reach not read

best_idea: A hunting creature keeps its target until it dies or leaves view, and swaps to whoever hit it last only if that attacker can be hit now or is nearer, which gives many-on-one fights one explainable target rule.
decision_why: Keep the sticky target, attackable-first pick and hitter swap in the engine; drop the per-tick stealth roll for duels because an engage is a state change.
acceptance: In a 3-vs-1 server test, a creature in reach that hit the hero last becomes the target on the next tick, a farther creature that never hit is not chosen, and the same seed gives the same target sequence on replay.
